$comment: IA for the terms.so clone. Section order transcribed from src/pages/*.jsx; shells and per-route facts from CLONE_SPEC.md (home) and CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md (sub-routes), both measured against the live site. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: https://terms.so/ (local clone at /Users/riyaghosh/V3/terms, React 18 + Vite + react-router-dom v6)
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; structure read from src/App.jsx routes and src/pages/*.jsx

categories.CHROME: Page-level navigation and footer chrome; varies by page shell (dark landing, light landing, app shell, none).
categories.DEMO: Looping animated product demo card on the home page, driven by the shared preview timeline engine.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of an informational page (about, changelog, docs).
categories.LEGAL: Blocks of the shared legal-document layout used by the policy pages.

chrome.landing-nav.description: Marketing nav row: logo mark on the left, About / Pricing / Login / Sign up pill links on the right. Takes a shell prop: white-alpha links on the dark gradient, #655c53/#161512 links on the light shells; current page is highlighted, and on the narrow docs shell the row stacks into a column at 600px and below.
chrome.landing-nav.scope: Present on the 5 landing-shell routes (home, about, pricing, changelog, docs).

chrome.landing-footer.description: Three-column marketing footer: orange logo with a one-paragraph product description, then Product and Company link columns. The Changelog link appears in the Product column only on the home page (5 Product links there, 4 everywhere else).
chrome.landing-footer.scope: Present on the 5 landing-shell routes; the Changelog-link variant is home-only.

chrome.app-header.description: Minimal 60px app-shell header: centred orange logo linking home and a small Sign in link on the right. No marketing nav links.
chrome.app-header.scope: Present on the 2 legal routes (privacy, terms).

hero.home-typewriter.description: Home hero on the dark gradient: four-line one-time typewriter headline (three muted lines, one bright), Sign up and Watch a demo chips that fade in after typing, and the decorative monospace prompt-text layer typing and erasing in the side gutters above roughly 1040px wide.

hero.page-typewriter.description: Sub-page hero on the dark gradient: the same one-time typewriter headline component with the first N default line timings, followed by a short intro paragraph (bold lead sentence plus muted continuation). No chips and no prompt-text layer.
hero.page-typewriter.scope: Present on the 2 dark sub-pages (about, pricing).

demo.draft-card.description: Draft with AI demo card (#draft, the Watch a demo target): a typed prompt becomes a chat on the left and a streamed agreement document on the right; 20-second loop.

demo.questions-card.description: Ask your contracts demo card: a typed question, a thinking state, a streamed answer and a cited clause card; 16-second loop.

demo.comments-card.description: Comment on contracts demo card: a cursor selects a clause, a comment and reply are typed, a payment term changes from 14 to 30 days, and the thread resolves; 21-second loop.

content.photo-stack.description: Interactive stack of three tilted studio photos: hover lifts a card, clicking the front card sends it to the back, clicking another brings it to the front with a toss animation.

content.trust-table.description: Centred safety paragraph (id=safety) followed by a white two-column Area / What we do table of 7 rows describing how the product handles hosting, data, access, signing, AI drafting, email and payments.

commerce.plan-cards.description: Row of four equal plan cards (Free, Plus, Pro, Max) each with a monthly price, a token-allowance line and a full-width orange Try it out button to sign-up; stacks on mobile. No billing toggle, feature list or highlighted tier.

content.changelog-header.description: Centred Changelog page heading with a short intro line, on the flat white wide shell.

content.changelog-releases.description: 880px release list: per release a date column beside a list of entries (bold title, short body, links to commits), collapsing to one column on mobile, ending in a small muted note.

content.docs-header.description: API reference page heading and intro on the narrow 720px white shell.

content.docs-sections.description: Single-column run of docs sections: h2/h3 headings, paragraphs, lists, grey monospace code blocks, bordered endpoint cards and a rendered contract example. No sidebar, table of contents, tabs or copy buttons.

legal.doc-switcher.description: Inline Privacy Policy / Terms of Service switcher at the top of the 768px legal container; the current document is unlinked.

legal.doc-header.description: Legal document title (h1) with a small Last updated date line.

legal.contents-card.description: On this page card: a numbered, two-column list of in-page anchor links to every section. Not sticky.

legal.numbered-sections.description: The numbered policy sections themselves, each an h2 followed by paragraphs and bullet lists (16 sections on privacy, 21 on terms).

legal.footer-row.description: Simple bordered footer row closing a legal document: a support email prompt, Back to top and Terms home links. Replaces the marketing footer on these routes.

auth.form-card.description: Centred 420px sign-in/sign-up form on white with no nav or footer: logo, title and subtitle, a grey Google button, a divider, a 52px pill email input, an orange Continue button, a switch-flow prompt and a Secured by footer. In this clone it is a static, non-functional mock.
auth.form-card.scope: Present on the 2 auth routes (sign-in, sign-up).
